title: Isaiah 13
paragraphs: ¹ The oracle concerning Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw. ² Raise a banner on a bare mountain, shout to them, wave your hand so they may enter the gates of the nobles. ³ I have commanded my consecrated ones; I have summoned my warriors, my proudly exulting ones, to carry out my wrath. ⁴ Listen, a sound on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The LORD of hosts is mustering an army for war. ⁵ They come from a distant land, from the far ends of the heavens — the LORD and the weapons of his wrath — to destroy the whole earth.

⁶ Wail, for the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty. ⁷ Because of this, every hand will go limp, and every heart will melt with fear. ⁸ Terror will seize them; pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will stare at each other, their faces aflame. ⁹ See, the day of the LORD is coming — a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger — to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it. ¹⁰ The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.

¹¹ I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their sin. I will put an end to the arrogance of the proud and humble the insolence of the ruthless. ¹² I will make mortals scarcer than pure gold, and humans rarer than the gold of Ophir. ¹³ Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the LORD of hosts, on the day of his burning anger. ¹⁴ Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep with no one to gather them, everyone will return to their own people, everyone will flee to their own land. ¹⁵ Everyone who is found will be thrust through; everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

¹⁶ Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives ravished. ¹⁷ See, I will stir up the Medes against them, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold. ¹⁸ Their bows will cut down the young men; they will have no mercy on newborns, no compassion for children. ¹⁹ And Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the glory of Babylonian pride, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah. ²⁰ It will never be inhabited or lived in for all generations; no nomad will pitch their tent there, no shepherd will rest their flocks there.

²¹ But desert creatures will lie there, and their houses will be filled with owls; ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about. ²² Hyenas will howl in their strongholds and jackals in their pleasant palaces. Her time is nearly come and her days will not be prolonged.
